responsibility: Declares the stack-oriented semantic builder used in pass 2 to construct detailed symbol-table entities and block metadata. It covers module/procedure scope setup, imports/exports, constants and variables, subranges, alignments, arrays, sets, records and variants, formal parameters and procedure types, no-return attributes, and constant-kind tracking helpers, making it the main declaration-and-type construction interface invoked from the pass-2 grammar.
same_name_distinction: This definition module declares the pass-2 symbol-building API used by P2Build; unlike P2SymBuild.mod, it specifies exported builder procedures and type-tracking helpers without implementing the declaration-construction logic.
